analog_rain_gauge.name: analog_rain_gauge
analog_rain_gauge.description: Measure and report rainfall, events and historical activity
analog_rain_gauge.build_widget_command: npm --prefix widget install && npm --prefix widget run build

analog_rain_gauge_dashboard.name: analog_rain_gauge_dashboard
analog_rain_gauge_dashboard.description: Farm dashboard aggregating every Analog Rain Gauge it can see - farm average / wettest / driest, a per-gauge table, rainfall-over-time, and an interpolated rainfall heatmap over a satellite basemap.
analog_rain_gauge_dashboard.build_widget_command: npm --prefix dashboard-widget install && npm --prefix dashboard-widget run build
